scope: cross-cutting improvements to current single-Agent and single-Worker architecture

opencode.approach: Adapt execution ownership, context headroom, finite loops and durable job continuation to existing Pi/SQLite; no OpenCode code/dependency transplant

implemented: UI-independent SessionController with single-run ownership, safe release and stale-event filtering
model context admission and output headroom; /context diagnostics and manual /compact guidance
four repeated identical tool failures on an unchanged workspace halt the turn; verification failure is an actual tool failure
park questions, close child and release its slot; explicitly resume the same child session/worktree
validate parent/connection/rules/question identity on continuation; original permissions and scope cannot expand
durable provider receipts and checkpoints settle only usage deltas on continuation
known-unsent cancellation releases unused reservation; unresolved sends stay reserved
ready/start admission, bounded process reaping and callback-failure cleanup preserved
atomic metadata, periodic updatedAt/liveness diagnostics, latest-first list and bounded private logs
real TUI commands for worker state/log/question-answer continuation; doctor capability flags corrected

dialogueScenarios: budget error then continued command access
runtime failure pause and explicit same-session resume
worker start, question park, log view, answer and same-worker resume

criticalEvidence: real Node/SDK children and Git worktrees; source workspace and binary bytes retained
question waiting child is absent before parent is reopened
child session ID preserved on continuation and saved question/answer present in model context
parent total equals child cumulative usage after two launches; no double charge
zero dispatched requests before admission gives zero unknown token reservation
observer exceptions do not leave the owned child alive
context rejection occurs with zero provider calls and no usage fabricated
four identical failures stop before a fifth provider request; a new user turn can retry

no cross-session/provider quota scheduler or full crash side-effect reconciliation
manual compaction remains; no background paid summarization
